description: This file defines the 'QueryThings' command class used for searching 'things' within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for constructing, parsing from JSON, and serializing the command, as well as handling command parameters such as filters, options, fields, and namespaces. The class implements the 'ThingSearchQueryCommand' interface and extends 'AbstractCommand', indicating its role within the command pattern architecture.

classes.name: QueryThings
classes.description: Immutable command class for querying 'things' with filters, options, fields, and namespaces parameters. Supports JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and string representation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new 'QueryThings' command instance with specified filter, options, fields, namespaces, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a 'QueryThings' command from a JSON string or JSON object and headers.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Returns the optional list of options.

methods.name: getNamespaces
methods.description: Returns the optional set of namespaces.

methods.name: setNamespaces
methods.description: Creates a new instance with the specified namespaces.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated headers.
